name: felidar_retreat_only_your_lands
note: Felidar Retreat: 'Landfall -- Whenever a land you control enters, choose one -- * Create a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token. ...' On the opponent's turn the opponent plays a Swamp: it is not P0's land, so nothing triggers (no mode is asked, no token). On P0's next turn P0 plays a Forest and takes the first mode: exactly one 2/2 Cat Beast token.
